scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=prod bun scripts/gen-host-scan.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outdir ./dist --external drizzle-kit --define SEAT_ENFORCE:true
scripts.build:obfuscate: cross-env NODE_ENV=prod bun scripts/gen-host-scan.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outdir ./dist --minify --external drizzle-kit --define SEAT_ENFORCE:true && bun scripts/obfuscate.ts
scripts.binary: cross-env NODE_ENV=prod bun scripts/gen-host-scan.ts && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod bun build src/index.ts --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile ./dist/service --external drizzle-kit --define SEAT_ENFORCE:true
scripts.binary:obfuscate: bun run build:obfuscate && cross-env NODE_ENV=prod bun build ./dist/index.js --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 --outfile ./dist/service --external drizzle-kit
scripts.docker:pack: bun run binary:obfuscate && docker build -t vome-service:latest . && docker save -o dist/vome-service.tar vome-service:latest && docker rmi vome-service:latest
